summary: Keep the agents roster published from one background refresher so roster reads and streams never wait for a fold

replay.detail: No claim replay or stored history changes.

schema.detail: No database schema, version or stored data changes.

rules.detail: No checkpoint rules or coordination changes; no coordinated upgrade required.

compatibility.detail: An agents WS window or first HTTP page that misses its exact cut is answered from the newest published roster, fenced at that roster's own snapshot index, which can be older than the reader's; streams reread once a newer roster is published. Response shapes are unchanged.

downtime.detail: No additional service interruption or startup migration is required. The daemon folds the roster in the background as it starts.

recovery.detail: Only volatile in-memory caches change; reverting restores per-read exact-cut folds.
